messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P0 - High 5xx rate from Redwood API (eu-west-1) — routing errors observed. Pager: @maria

maria: Ack'd, I'm on it. Seeing spike ~08:20 UTC, hitting /v1/generate primarily. Starting triage.

alex: I'm joining. Any deploys around that time?

deploy-bot: Deploy detected: service=serving-runtime env=prod region=eu-west-1 user=ci-cd pipeline=main-2026-03-10 08:15:03Z commit=ab3f4c

maria: Yep saw that deploy. Rolling logs now. Putting a quick mitigation plan: 1) rollback if deploy linked, 2) enable routing fallback to model-compat, 3) scale extra capacity.

sam: Quick ask — how bad is customer impact? Percent 5xx vs baseline?

maria: Rough numbers: 12% error rate peak on 08:21, now ~9%. A subset of customers on eu-west routes only. Support impact likely medium-high for paid tenants.

support-bot: Notifying support: "Potential API instability in eu-west-1; ETA for update 30m" linked ticket: RD-INC-4221.

alex: I can roll back that deploy if we confirm it's the culprit. Maria, can you paste the failing stack trace snippets?

maria: Logs show KV cache miss + segfault in optimized attention kernel on GPU nodes. Snippet:
```
E 08:20:24 serving-runtime: kernel_launch failed: invalid device pointer
E 08:20:24 model-loader: kv_cache_index out-of-bounds
```

tina: That looks like a model/kernel mismatch after the build. Could be a kernel selection change in the new runtime. If rollback, we should pin to previous runtime+kernel.

maria: Agreed. Alex, if you can rollback to commit ab3f3b (previous) that will avoid the new kernel. Do it with canary to confirm.

alex: Starting rollback to ab3f3b, canary in eu-west-1 (1/5 nodes). Will monitor.

(6m later)

alex: Canary looks good — no 5xxs on canary. Rolling rest back.

maria: Post-rollback numbers: 5xx down to 0.8% across region. Good.

sam: Great. We'll keep an eye for 15m to ensure stabilization, then postmortem.

evan: I'm on after-shift soon. Maria, can I take the handoff and lead the postmortem coordination once things are stable?

maria: Yes. Handoff: system stabilized at 08:35 UTC, rollback confirmed. Evan will take post-incident follow-up.

support-bot: Updating ticket RD-INC-4221 — incident mitigated via rollback. Marking customers notified.

maria: Thanks all. Let's schedule a postmortem to capture root cause and action items. Propose Tue 10:00 UTC (48h). Facilitator needed — volunteer? We should include infra, runtime, model-onboarding, support, and SRE.

alex: I can facilitate if nothing else. I wrote a quick incident timeline draft in the incident ticket; can take facilitator role.

tina: I'll attend for RCA and kernel selection details.

sam: I'll be there for deployment/process notes.

evan: I'll own the postmortem doc and follow-ups. Alex, if you facilitate, can you lead the first 30 min and then hand the doc to me to maintain?

alex: Yep. Plan: 30m triage recap + timeline, 30m RCA deep-dive, 15m actions & owners. Evan please create the doc and calendar invite, include bridge.

evan: Will do. Draft doc link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/PMT-4221 (placeholder) — sending calendar invite for Tue 10:00 UTC to: alex, tina, sam, maria, support-oncall.

maria: Add customer impact notes and any CS messages to the agenda.

support-bot: Suggested attendee list from support: jess, rick, lydia. Adding to invite.

alex: Facilitator checklist: 1) capture timeline (maria), 2) capture logs & deploys (alex), 3) RCA owner (tina), 4) mitigation verification (sam), 5) follow-up owners & due dates (evan).

evan: Adding action items to the doc now and assigning temporary owners: RD-ACTION-527: add kernel compatibility tests (tina) due in 2w; RD-ACTION-528: release gating check for kernel selection (sam) due in 1w; RD-ACTION-529: improve deploy rollback runbook (alex) due in 3d.

alex: Good. Also add a quick test: add a pre-deploy smoke that verifies model K/V indexing on canary nodes. (sam + tina)

sam: noted. I'll scope the smoke test and link PR to RD-ACTION-528.

maria: One more: vendor kernel packages pinned? Tina, can you check compatibility with the vendor-provided optimized kernels and include in the postmortem?

tina: On it — I'll include binary/version matrix.

maria: Thanks everyone. Evan, please post the calendar invite + doc link and set reminder 24h before. Also leave the thread open for any follow-ups.

evan: Invite sent. Postmortem facilitator: alex. Doc owner: evan. Will circulate draft 24h before meeting.

support-bot: Customer communications: initial notice sent, follow-up scheduled after postmortem. Ticket RD-INC-4221 updated.

alex: Closing operational thread here — great job on quick mitigation. We'll capture lessons in the postmortem. :thumbsup:

maria: +1. Thanks team.

(incidents thread archived by incident-bot)
__notes: Slack thread JSON for incident -> postmortem scheduling and facilitator assignment. No title field per agents.md. All fields are strings or list of strings.
